answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 35605 Country: India Title: I want to know if Nikah remains in existence if the couple whose marriage has been solemnized four years ago, but still they have no physical relation as the marriage was done forcefully Question: I want to know if Nikah remains in existence if the couple whose marriage has been solemnized four years ago, but still they have no physical relation as the marriage was done forcefully. None of them has any problem in their reproduction system none of them has any problem in them biologically. And after how many days Nikah will diminish if no physical contact has been done if both are biologically fit and are capable of reproduction. Kindly reply me as soon as possible. Answer ID: 35605 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1902/L=574/TL=1432) If husband and wife do not have intercourse for a long time it does not have any effect on the nikah. Nikah comes to and end by giving talaq or doing khula. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
